svg.title: The p99 latency of each server at fixed rates, colibri against other servers
svg.desc: p99 latency at each rate oha offers, with the bound of 10 ms. h11: colibri sustains 40,000 req/s, chi sustains 40,000 req/s, axum sustains 40,000 req/s, http.zig sustains 40,000 req/s, Fastify sustains 10,000 req/s; h2: colibri sustains 40,000 req/s, chi sustains 20,000 req/s, axum sustains 40,000 req/s, Fastify sustains 10,000 req/s; h2 over TLS: colibri sustains 40,000 req/s, chi sustains 10,000 req/s, axum sustains 40,000 req/s, Fastify sustains no rate; h3: colibri sustains 20,000 req/s, chi sustains 10,000 req/s, axum sustains 20,000 req/s.
svg.text: p99 latency at each rate oha offers, with the bound of 10 ms
oha sends GET requests over the GitHub API's routes at fixed rates, with its latency correction. A filled point is a rate
the server sustained: every answer 200, 95% of the rate reached, and p99 under 10 ms. Over h3, chi runs on quic-go,
and axum on quinn. Each server runs on a core of its own. One run of bench.yml measured all: run 44445591237, commit 89045d95,
